summary: Verified Emergent Google sign-in integration alongside existing JWT auth. Backend: 31/31 pytest tests pass, including 3 new tests for POST /api/auth/google/session (invalid session_id -> 401, empty body -> 422, empty string -> 401). All 3 seeded roles (super_admin sabnamrajoria@gmail.com, admin admin@komorebi.cafe, customer guest@komorebi.cafe) log in via email/password and land on correct routes (/admin, /admin, /book). New customer registration still issues JWT. Frontend: 'Continue with Google' button (data-testid=google-signin) present on /login and /register; clicking it redirects to https://auth.emergentagent.com/?redirect=<encoded app origin>/ (verified via route intercept - actual Google login NOT performed). AuthCallback flow verified: visiting /#session_id=fakeXYZ123 renders the 'Signing you in…' screen, backend returns 401 for the fake session, frontend redirects to /login and shows an error toast ('Google sign-in failed. Please try again.') — no infinite spinner, no crash. JWT is correctly stored in localStorage as komorebi_token. AuthProvider correctly skips /auth/me when hash contains session_id.
critical_code_review_comments: Minor: backend/tests/backend_test.py previously used owner@komorebi.cafe (non-existent) as super_admin credential — fixed to sabnamrajoria@gmail.com. Main agent should ensure SUPER_ADMIN_EMAIL stays in sync with seeded owner across environments (env-driven, currently correct).

Minor: server.py line 381 reads os.environ['SUPER_ADMIN_EMAIL'] inside the Google flow without lowercasing before comparison — currently .lower() is applied at call time, OK, but wrapping in a module-level constant would avoid repeated env lookups and make the mapping explicit.

AuthProvider hash-detection is one-shot on mount; if a user opens the SPA already authenticated and then triggers a Google sign-in without full reload, the auth-me skip won't re-fire. Not an issue for current UX (Google flow always full-page redirects), just noting.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (6/6 core flows: google btn on /login, google btn on /register, redirect URL correctness, customer login, admin login, super_admin login, fake session_id -> /login redirect)

test_credentials: Super Admin sabnamrajoria@gmail.com/Owner@123, Admin admin@komorebi.cafe/Admin@123, Customer guest@komorebi.cafe/Guest@123 — all verified working via JWT
seed_data_creation: None (used existing seeded users). Test-created records prefixed with TEST_.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Google auth uses Emergent-managed session exchange: frontend redirects to https://auth.emergentagent.com/?redirect=<origin>/, on return the URL hash contains session_id=XXX which triggers <AuthCallback/> in App.js. POST /api/auth/google/session {session_id} -> returns {access_token, user} (same shape as /auth/login). Cannot automate full round-trip (needs real Google account) — verify via (a) redirect URL captured by route.abort, (b) fake session_id -> 401 -> /login redirect with error toast. JWT is in localStorage 'komorebi_token'. Test file: /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (pytest, class-based).
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found. All regression + new-feature acceptance criteria met.
